initial_latent: new seed-specific Glorot uniform shared across conditions
selection: fit game count >=10 NBA/>=20 tennis, one pass filtering, retain only all-member-eligible rows; training-unobserved members excluded from final evaluation

NBA.fit: existing C31 fit, not D validation
NBA.context: existing home/period/start elapsed/start differential; fit scaling

tennis.split: sorted tourney_id shuffled Python Random(17), round(20% groups) test; already inventoried split unchanged
tennis.reuse: team-game equal weight; both directions kept together; svpt>0 and all three rate definitions finite
tennis.completed: nonempty score without RET/W/O/DEF/ABD; no numeric ability filtering

source_primary: cycle20, no early stopping; fit trajectories only; no final test until all training tasks complete
predictor: fixed latent only,64->16->1,20epoch,L2 kernels,source and three other outputs independently

baseline.ridge: raw role-separated 0/1 ID, intercept, mean MSE + .01 sum(coef²)
baseline.logistic: raw role-separated 0/1 ID, intercept, mean BCE + .01 sum(coef²)

perturbation: final predictor all-zero and fixed row shuffle, source Finders also stored separately

bootstrap.paired: same sampled clusters across conditions and all three seeds; CI of mean paired loss differences
bootstrap.scope: evaluation-cluster uncertainty conditional on fitted models

numeric: float32, no mixed precision/TF32, deterministic ops where supported
test_policy: no final metric before global train_complete marker; target preparation not performance evaluation
